comment: No source is published: the repository holds only a README, a changelog and two screenshots. Parameter 16, named always1, is configured with a range of 1 to 1, has no ParamWidget and is read nowhere in process, so it gets no line and no tag. The maker's README says the fade slider runs to about 5 seconds; configParam gives it a range of 0 to 3 and the value is used as the time constant of a one-pole, so the code was followed. The README says the swap buttons only affect the output in the parallel mode's counterpart, the sequential mode. In fact each stage's mix knob and bypass button stay with the stage while the path moves, so a swap changes the parallel output too whenever the two stages differ. The main outputs are clamped to plus or minus 12V in the chain mode and to plus or minus 10V in the parallel mode; the sends are clamped to plus or minus 12V in both. In the parallel mode all three sends carry the main input whichever paths the stages choose, so two stages pointed at one path leave another path sent to but never returned. The 1000-sample threshold that separates a trigger from a gate on the bypass CV inputs is a sample count, not a time, so it moves with the sample rate: about 23ms at 44.1kHz. The module declares Rack's own bypass on the main L and R jacks, so the right-click Bypass passes the input straight to the output. There is no custom context menu.
